With BOP 3.9 mT the sensor already switches ~4 mm of travel before full latch (sphere of radius ~5 mm); use a higher-threshold part/TMAG threshold (>= 20 mT -> +-3 mm) and rely on the needle depth mechanics for the final 1.9 mm.

gear_pair.formula: 0.35 / (20 x 26.45 x ratio) x 74.63 / 10, ratio = z_screw / z_motor

If no <= 1.2 mm part is found: mount the connector on the board bottom side outside the dock arms (needs a layout change) or recess the lid locally (wall would drop below 0.4 mm: not acceptable).
